hero.title: Become a Member
hero.subtitle: Have you been looking to volunteer for good causes? Do you like helping kids and feeling like you made a difference? There's a place for you here.

why.title: More Than Volunteering - It's a Community
why.intro: Kiwanis membership is about friendship, purpose, and impact. Here's what you gain when you join the Winchester club.

feature.imageAlt: Children in the Winchester community supported by Kiwanis volunteers
feature.headline: Kids in Winchester need people who show up.
feature.body: Every Wednesday at noon, Kiwanis members do exactly that - for over a century.
